kept.poolKey: First-Survey qualification (the reading is a first look)
kept.spine: The safety reading for Hochhausen is a first one. It states what has been seen and nothing about what has not.
A stranger asking after the arrangements at Hochhausen is met with plain incomprehension. Whether that is honest or a good act is not said.
The town has an edge rather than a boundary at Hochhausen, and the edge is wherever the last building happens to stand.
The town has no answer to what it cannot see, and stands unprepared rather than protected there.
No wall marks where Hochhausen ends. At this size, the country and the town simply agree to differ.
The town eats what arrives by road, and has nothing put by for a season when nothing does.
